title: Figure 37: Evaluation of Object Sightings in Strategic Areas of the South West Region
description: Regional map of the US Southwest showing an outlined cross-shaped strategic area labeled "98 object sightings Albuquerque", linked to a pie chart of evaluations (Astro 42.9%, Unknown 21.4%, Aircraft 16.4%, plus Other, Insuf. info. and Balloon). A second pie gives the "Balance of South West Region" (125 object sightings), with Unknown at 25.6%. Caption: "FIGURE 37 COMPARISON OF EVALUATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS IN THE STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE SOUTH WEST REGION"; drawing A-7515.
